speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Says 'We are the True Disciples, executors of God's will', calls the Exalted Ones あの方達, chants of salvation; generic True Disciple soldier, not Space Demon King

proposed_by_v_g338_00.basis: Says 'We are the True Disciples, executors of God's will', calls the Exalted Ones あの方達, chants of salvation; generic True Disciple soldier, not Space Demon King

proposed_by_v_g338_01.basis: Generic True Disciple (真徒) soldier: refers to himself as 真徒, calls the Exalted Ones あの方, shouts Salus, speaks of Advent-style purging; not Space Demon King

proposed_by_v_g338_02.basis: Calls himself a True Disciple, speaks of the Exalted Ones' protection, scorns Z-BLUE's Gundams/Getter/Spheres; Jigoku's Space Demon King does not fit

proposed_by_v_g338_03.basis: Imperious, calls foes お前/愚者, preaches purification, rebirth and God's grace, orders 'chant Salus' (the True Disciples' chant, used by Holy Advent in dlg_2106_11); lines overlap the Neo Reactor g191 lines (虚空/輪廻へと還れ, 恩寵). Jigoku said Space Demon King (differs).

338:0.en: 「I relay the words of God's emissary」

338:104.en: 「Know your sins are your own doing」

338:189.en: 「We are the $$真徒$$s... Executors of God's will...」

338:226.en: 「We are the guardians of the law...!」

338:447.en: 「This is the universe of the gods」

338:476.en: 「Insolent wretch, trampling into the\nuniverse where the gods dwell」

338:597.en: 「No need to trouble the Exalted Ones」

338:638.en: 「Behold the power the Exalted Ones gave」

338:994.en: 「This is the power of the chosen!」

338:1125.en: 「Fool! Back to the cycle of rebirth!」

338:1226.en: 「Who said it was just one attack?」

338:1308.en: 「Don't think tools made by foolish\nhumans can beat us!」

338:1361.en: 「Human wit is futile before divine power!」

338:1404.en: 「A product of fire's civilization, a Gundam!」

338:1472.en: 「$$ガンダム$$!\nA beacon existing across parallel worlds!」

338:1523.en: 「I'll destroy the Gundams of all worlds!」

338:1560.en: 「You may go no further\ndown the path of $$シンカ$$!」

338:1609.en: 「Your evolution is merely\nthe doorway to $$シンカ$$!」

338:1742.en: 「These too are sprouts of evolution...\nNo, bearers of the seed!」

338:1793.en: 「Too weak to be a mechanical supergod!」

338:1865.en: 「Whatever feelings you pour in,\nhuman civilization can't beat us!」

338:1930.en: 「A Demon God of Light can't match a true god!」

338:2028.en: 「I'll sever the bud of possibility\nhidden in the child here!」

338:2079.en: 「Cower, child!\nWe embody the will of God!」

338:2134.en: 「Only the Exalted Ones may\nraise the sun aloft!」

338:2189.en: 「Even the moonlight that lights\nthe dark is denied to you!」

338:2240.en: 「Twin factors of light and dark end here!」

338:2279.en: 「Love has no power in this universe!」

338:2320.en: 「Shed all the blood of the beast here!」

338:2359.en: 「Truly the one best suited to the words\n'doesn't know their place'!」

338:2410.en: 「God doesn't recognize anything born\nof the mingling of waters!」

338:2506.en: 「Mediator of the world! Hold your tongue!」

338:2578.en: 「Miracles don't happen! I won't allow them!」

338:2621.en: 「You who felled $$バアル$$ end here too!」

338:2662.en: 「The wind's destination is beyond the causal horizon!」

338:2697.en: 「I'll break that drill with God's will!」

338:2730.en: 「Power to alter the natural order ends here!」

338:2771.en: 「Pay for trying to bend divine providence!」

338:2814.en: 「That power is not permitted to humanity!」

338:2847.en: 「Don't think tools of human wars\ncan work on us!」

338:2980.en: 「Wings that carry feelings...\nI'll tear them off!」

338:3154.en: 「One qualified as heir!\nProstrate yourself before us!」

338:3203.en: 「I'll show you the fate of the fool\nwho challenged God!」

338:3301.en: 「The man who buried a grotesque god?!」

338:3334.en: 「A weapon may not seek a life\nas a human!」

338:3391.en: 「You who kill your own kind\nare not worth saving!」

338:3442.en: 「Offer that $$スフィア$$ to the Exalted Ones!」

338:3479.en: 「When all the $$スフィア$$s gather,\nthe universe is saved!」

338:3530.en: 「Well done,\nawakening $$スフィア$$ power this far!」

338:3734.en: 「You have no place in this world!」

338:3765.en: 「I'll send you to the next life!」

338:3796.en: 「The gospel will lead you to heaven!」

338:3921.en: 「Your chance to atone for your sins!」

338:4043.en: 「It's time to atone for your sins!」

338:4122.en: 「What I give you is divine wrath.」

338:4186.en: 「You had to know this would happen.」

338:4308.en: 「I only show you the natural result.」

338:4389.en: 「Atone for the sin of attacking us.」

338:4571.en: 「Helping an emissary of God\nis my happiness.」

338:4655.en: 「Protecting my comrades is also my duty!」

338:4686.en: 「My iron will shall be the shield!」

338:4717.en: 「This body... I have already offered to you.」

338:4758.en: 「This is my deepest wish! My happiness!」

338:4849.en: 「Each of us is a one-man army.」

338:4880.en: 「Comrades and I will purge this fool!」

338:4913.en: 「No time to worry about your allies!」

338:5306.en: 「That one's tactics\nhave outdone me, a $$真徒$$...!」

338:5359.en: 「That was a good chance to know your place.」

338:5394.en: 「It is all in the palm of my hand.」

338:5514.en: 「I can read your moves ten steps ahead.」

338:5553.en: 「Do you see now? Resisting is futile.」

338:5664.en: 「Even a Gundam is, in the end,\na product of human civilization.」

338:5756.en: 「If you had knelt to the Exalted Ones,\nyou could have become $$真徒$$s.」

338:5809.en: 「A giant god of steel is nothing but a human idol.」

338:5844.en: 「Truly a raging giant god.\nThe word 'pathetic' says it all.」

338:5918.en: 「You fall short of bearing the sun.」

338:5990.en: 「You seem unable to draw out the power of light.」

338:6073.en: 「Mechanical Angel,\nwill you not avenge the $$天翅$$s?」

338:6128.en: 「That you've survived until now\nwas mere luck, it seems.」

338:6185.en: 「Is this the miracle you speak of?」

338:6214.en: 「There are worlds that effort and\nguts can never reach.」

338:6292.en: 「A fake god gets no further than this.」

338:6327.en: 「Neither love nor feelings can reach us.」

338:6411.en: 「Is that the power of your $$スフィア$$?」

338:6444.en: 「After all, $$スフィア$$s are only keys.」

338:6483.en: 「Why did you think that would work?」

338:6518.en: 「This too is the protection of the Exalted Ones.」

338:6586.en: 「Why do you think this is enough to fight?」

338:6733.en: 「So this is what you call an attack.」

338:6760.en: 「Do you not intend to reflect on your actions?」

338:6799.en: 「I will give you credit for landing that hit.」

338:6826.en: 「Your heart must be about to break.」

338:6938.en: 「I need to revise my view a little.」

338:6971.en: 「I see...\nAs expected of one with the $$烙印$$.」

338:7020.en: 「It's been 2,208 cycles since\nI had a real fight...」

338:7075.en: 「It's no fun unless it's like this!」

338:7106.en: 「No wonder you could force\nyour way into this universe!」

338:7198.en: 「Do you have the power to make\nus get serious...!?」

338:7292.en: 「Oh...! That I...\na $$真徒$$, should be wounded!」

338:7349.en: 「Impossible...!\nA $$真徒$$ is supposed to be invincible!」

338:7398.en: 「You surpass even the protection of the Exalted Ones!」

338:7439.en: 「This is the power of Multiverse Release...!?」

338:7568.en: 「The power around that one...! Human feelings!?」

338:8015.en: 「This is God's...\nNo, that man's firm will and pride!」

338:8129.en: 「Mingling of waters...!\nA power that melds all into the new!」

338:8188.en: 「This is the man who killed a god...!」

338:8215.en: 「Now I'm being shown a miracle\nthat humans make...!」

338:8266.en: 「Hard work and guts...!\nThat's human power seeking tomorrow!」

338:8323.en: 「No ceiling to Spiral power at all!?」

338:8405.en: 「The power of life...!\nTheir song shakes our hearts!」

338:8456.en: 「Machine and human fuse,\ncreating a new power!?」

338:8564.en: 「So this is the true Sphere power!」

338:8855.en: 「God! Protect a poor wretch like me!」

338:9092.en: 「I gave my life to the Exalted Ones!\nI feel no fear!」

338:9155.en: 「A $$真徒$$ on the $$シンカ$$ path,\nI'm a being beyond humanity!」

338:9257.en: 「All around that one closes in on me!」

338:9584.en: 「Weren't we on the path of $$シンカ$$\nall along!?」

338:9709.en: 「Lies!\nWe were meant to pass myth's end...!」
